rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Assists with containerization workflows including intelligent Dockerfile generation, Docker image building and scanning, Kubernetes manifest generation, and application deployment. Features a policy-driven system using OPA Rego for security enforcement, knowledge-enhanced recommendations, and built-in prompt loops for local Kind cluster development and Azure Kubernetes Service deployment. Supports vulnerability scanning via Trivy integration.
